headline: Local RWA President Demands Immediate 'Leadership Change' After Neighbor Strikes His Unauthorized Terrace Garden
body:
The president of the Gulmohar Heights Residents' Welfare Association, Mr. Suresh Malhotra, issued an official notice Tuesday calling for a leadership change in the building’s third-floor household, citing 'escalated tactical strikes' against his unauthorized balcony-fence garden. Mr. Malhotra, who has been managing the building's common area greenery, slammed the third-floor resident for recently installing a heavy-duty mesh screen that blocked his tomato plants from getting sufficient sunlight.

'This is a violation of our shared-space sovereignty,' said Mr. Malhotra, while gesturing toward a wilting basil pot. 'By deploying high-density physical barriers to negate my vertical farming initiatives, the resident has clearly demonstrated he is not fit for co-habitation. I have already sent a formal request to the block secretary demanding that the third-floor kitchen be decommissioned until they agree to dismantle the screening system.'

Independent observers of the society, including the local milkman who delivers to both apartments, noted that the third-floor resident was merely trying to keep pigeons off his balcony railing. 'I think they just need to sit down with a cup of tea, but Mr. Malhotra is convinced this is a geopolitical crisis involving the future of his balcony terrace,' said the milkman. As of Tuesday evening, the RWA president was seen drafting a resolution to sanction the third-floor apartment’s electricity supply if the 'sunlight embargo' was not lifted within 24 hours.
caption: When a balcony dispute gets treated like a full-blown international security crisis. 🍅🌿 #RWADrama #TerraceGardening #SocietyLife #NeighborWars (satire)
igHook: Tag that one neighbor in your building who acts like they run the entire country.
